purpose: Raw licence-server export, one row per record, deliberately messy (duplicates, missing logouts, bad timestamps, bad ids...).
how_to_use: Input to validation. Do not use for analytics.

purpose: Validated sessions - the table every metric is built from.
how_to_use: Use this for any session-level analysis. Telemetry fields blank when telemetry_available=false.

purpose: Row-level outcome for every raw row: status, primary exclusion reason, all flags, cleaning action.
how_to_use: Audit trail: shows exactly why each row was kept or dropped.

purpose: One row per validation check: rows flagged, rows excluded as primary reason, action taken.
how_to_use: Reconciles to the excluded-row total.

purpose: Headline data-quality score, exclusions by reason, dimension scores, warnings.
how_to_use: data_quality_score_percent is the number for the dashboard header.

purpose: Data-quality pass rate per software (plus UNKNOWN for unrecognised ids).
how_to_use: Optional per-software badge.

purpose: Licences purchased/usable, cost assumptions, renewal dates, notice deadline, criticality.
how_to_use: All prices synthetic. Join key for everything.

purpose: One row per project x phase x software: dates, team size, phase intensity, expected concurrent users.
how_to_use: Planning input for the forecast. Includes planned phases through Jun 2027.

purpose: Synthetic user master incl. leavers (account_status, last_working_date).
how_to_use: Join for user view.

purpose: Which user is entitled to which software and why (project vs legacy access).
how_to_use: Lets the user view show entitlements that were never used.

purpose: Checkouts refused because all licences were in use. The direct evidence of shortage.
how_to_use: Fixes the old blind spot: unmet demand is now observable.

purpose: Proposed default thresholds and cost assumptions for Members 2-3 (buffer, tolerance, temp-licence price, Possible/Confirmed rule).
how_to_use: Team should confirm or change before use.

purpose: One row per software: licences purchased/available/occupied, users, duration, peak hours, idle, utilisation, denials, trend, renewal.
how_to_use: Feeds the software-wise dashboard and recommendations.

purpose: Software x month: sessions, hours, peak, utilisation, denials, idle.
how_to_use: Trend charts.

purpose: Software x hour of day: avg / p95 / max occupied licences on business days.
how_to_use: Peak-hours chart.

purpose: Software x weekday x hour: avg occupied licences.
how_to_use: Heat-map chart.

purpose: Department x software usage, share of hours, denials, idle.
how_to_use: Department drill-down.

purpose: User x entitled software: sessions, hours, last use, idle, denials, usage segment.
how_to_use: Feeds the user-wise dashboard (dormant / never used / leaver).

purpose: One row per user: entitlements vs used, hours, last use, segment.
how_to_use: User table / bar graph.

purpose: Zero-filled date x software table with demand targets AND schedule features (history 2026-01-01..2026-09-30).
how_to_use: Training/validation table. suggested_split: train <= 2026-07-31, holdout after.

purpose: Same schedule features for 2026-10-01..2027-03-31 (no targets).
how_to_use: Forecast inputs - predict demand for these rows.

purpose: Software x phase: avg planned users vs observed demand.
how_to_use: Shows the schedule really drives demand.

purpose: Ground truth: how many messy records of each type the generator injected (compare with validation_report.json).
how_to_use: Proves the validator catches what was planted.

purpose: Result of the independent self-test (code/qa_checks.py).
how_to_use: All rows should be PASS.
